faqs.q: Which sectors does Ertone work in?
faqs.a: Our biggest sectors are airlines, construction and hospitality. We also make parts for automation, sport, defence, energy, electrical and packaging customers.
Yes. Ertone is ISO 9001 certified, and the certificate is available on the downloads page.

faqs.q: Can you support low volume runs and prototypes?
faqs.a: Yes. We can supply prototype parts before tooling, then run low or high volumes from the production tool.

faqs.q: What does the quote process involve?
faqs.a: Send a drawing, a sample or an idea. An engineer reviews it, then we send a quote with material and tooling recommendations.

about.title: About Ertone | UK Injection Moulders Since 1982
about.description: Ertone Plastics has designed and manufactured precision injection moulded plastic components in the UK since 1982. ISO 9001 certified, based in Aylesbury.
about.hero_text: UK injection moulders, in operation since 1982.
story: Established in 1982, Ertone Plastics has built a strong reputation as a quality designer and manufacturer of precision injection moulded plastic components.

Everything from airline trolley trays, plastic jugs and glasses through to first aid boxes, cutlery and receptacles of almost any shape and size. We have supplied some of the world's largest and most demanding companies for decades, always upholding the Ertone standard of quality.
